claims: lake build at 9996995 (Lean v4.35.0) succeeded (3164 jobs, cached); direct re-elaboration of MathResearch/ECDLP/LinearInterp.lean via lake env lean exited 0 with no output.
Round8Axioms.lean: both degree_bound_of_x_relations_linear and degree_bound_linear_short_weierstrass depend only on propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

The curve statement matches Theorem C: a1=a2=a3=0, (2:F)!=0, addOrderOf P = r, 2N<r, g(x(kP)) = (k:F) (k mod char) for 1<=k<=N implies N <= 3 natDegree g + 2; xCoord junk value at infinity is never used (kP != 0 and injectivity are proved).

Scope: r = 0 (infinite order) makes 2N<r unsatisfiable, so the Lean theorem covers only finite-order P; irrelevant over finite fields. No discriminant hypothesis needed, so the statement is at least as general as Theorem C. Docstring says 'odd order' but oddness is not assumed.
Hypotheses are jointly satisfiable: toy instance y^2=x^3+x+6 over F_7, P=(4,2) of order 11, N=4, g=4X+6 (checked in Python, not in Lean).
